info.name: Tareeq Admin — Read-Only Verification
info.description: Safe verification only. Contains GET /auth/me plus Admin GET list/detail requests. It has no login, POST, PATCH, DELETE, publish, archive, or logout requests. Use an existing authenticated Postman Cookie Jar session for one role at a time. Detail requests are skipped when their list response has no record.

variable.description: Set to ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN before each separate run; never place credentials here.

exec: pm.test('documented success envelope', () => { pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('object'); });

request.description: Requires an existing Postman Cookie Jar session. Does not log in or change authentication state.

exec: const data = pm.response.json().data; const items = data.items;

item.name: GET country detail from list UUID

exec: const item = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('country detail UUID and Arabic fields', () => { pm.expect(item.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('countryId')); ['nameAr','introductionAr','detailsAr','status'].forEach((key) => pm.expect(item).to.have.property(key)); });

request.description: Skipped when the list has no record; record this as NOT VERIFIED — NO DATA.

exec: const data = pm.response.json().data; const items = data.items;

pm.test('university country relationship', () => items.forEach((item) => { ['id','slug','nameAr','officialName','countryId','cityAr','overviewAr','status'].forEach((key) => pm.expect(item).to.have.property(key)); pm.expect(item.countryId).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i); if (item.country) pm.expect(item.country.id).to.eql(item.countryId); }));

item.name: GET university detail from list UUID

exec: const item = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('university detail UUID and country UUID', () => { pm.expect(item.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('universityId')); pm.expect(item.countryId).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i); });

request.description: Skipped when the list has no record.

exec: const data = pm.response.json().data; const items = data.items;

pm.test('scholarship states and nullable relationships', () => items.forEach((item) => { ['id','titleAr','studyLevel','fundingType','requirementsAr','descriptionAr','applicationStatus','status'].forEach((key) => pm.expect(item).to.have.property(key)); pm.expect(item.status).to.be.oneOf(['DRAFT','PUBLISHED','ARCHIVED']); pm.expect(item.applicationStatus).to.be.oneOf(['OPEN','CLOSED']); pm.expect(item.effectiveApplicationStatus).to.be.oneOf(['OPEN','CLOSED']); ['countryId','universityId','verifiedDeadline','officialSourceUrl'].forEach((key) => pm.expect(item[key] === null || typeof item[key] === 'string').to.eql(true)); }));

item.name: GET scholarship detail from list UUID

exec: const item = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('scholarship detail preserves distinct states', () => { pm.expect(item.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('scholarshipId')); pm.expect(item.status).to.be.oneOf(['DRAFT','PUBLISHED','ARCHIVED']); pm.expect(item.applicationStatus).to.be.oneOf(['OPEN','CLOSED']); });

exec: const data = pm.response.json().data; const items = data.items; const blockTypes = ['paragraph','heading2','heading3','bulleted-list','numbered-list','quote'];

pm.test('article flat structured blocks and nullable relations', () => items.forEach((item) => { ['id','titleAr','summaryAr','bodyAr','bodyEn','countryId','universityId','scholarshipId','status'].forEach((key) => pm.expect(item).to.have.property(key)); pm.expect(item.bodyAr).to.be.an('array'); item.bodyAr.forEach((block) => { pm.expect(block.type).to.be.oneOf(blockTypes); pm.expect(block.text).to.be.a('string'); }); pm.expect(item.bodyEn === null || Array.isArray(item.bodyEn)).to.eql(true); ['countryId','universityId','scholarshipId'].forEach((key) => pm.expect(item[key] === null || /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(item[key])).to.eql(true)); }));

item.name: GET article detail from list UUID

exec: const item = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('article detail UUID and block format', () => { pm.expect(item.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('articleId')); pm.expect(item.bodyAr).to.be.an('array'); item.bodyAr.forEach((block) => pm.expect(block).to.have.all.keys('type', 'text')); });
